name: brightdata-mcp
description: Enhance AI Agents with Real-Time Web Data via Bright Data's web scraping and unblocking services
long_description: The official Bright Data Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables LLMs to access, discover and extract web data in real-time. This server allows MCP clients to seamlessly search the web, navigate websites, take action and retrieve data - without getting blocked - perfect for scraping tasks. Features include search engine scraping, web page scraping as markdown/HTML, structured data extraction from popular sites, and browser automation capabilities.

tools.name: search_engine
tools.description: Search Google. Returns organic results as JSON (link, title, description), about 10 per page. Use it to find pages and current information; read a result with scrape_as_markdown. Use search_engine_batch for several queries at once.

tools.name: scrape_as_markdown
tools.description: Fetch one web page through Bright Data and return its text, with links and code kept and other formatting removed (links: false for text only). The default way to read a page: faster and more reliable than the browser. Use scrape_batch for 2 to 5 URLs, and the scraping_browser_* tools only if this returns empty or blocked content or the page needs JavaScript, scrolling or clicking. For LinkedIn, company databases, Glassdoor or Indeed, list_scrapers returns structured data.

tools.name: search_engine_batch
tools.description: Run 2 to 5 Google searches at once, like search_engine. Returns a JSON list with, for each query, its organic results (link, title, description) or an error.

tools.name: scrape_batch
tools.description: Fetch 2 to 5 web pages at once, like scrape_as_markdown. Returns a JSON list in the order given: {status: "fulfilled", value: {url, content}} for a page that worked, or {status: "rejected", reason} for one that failed.

tools.name: scrape_as_html
tools.description: Fetch one web page through Bright Data and return its raw HTML. Much larger than scrape_as_markdown: use it only when you need markup such as attributes, tables or embedded data.

tools.name: list_scrapers
tools.description: List every Bright Data pre-built scraper available here (LinkedIn, Crunchbase, PitchBook, ZoomInfo, Owler, Glassdoor, Indeed). Returns dataset_id, name, domain and collection_methods. Next: call get_scraper_details with a dataset_id and one method.

tools.name: get_scraper_details
tools.description: Show the scraper description, input fields, example input and main output field names for one method. Call before run_scraper and build the input from sample_input or input_fields. Records may contain more fields than output_fields lists.

tools.name: run_scraper
tools.description: Run a scraper method. input is a list of objects shaped like sample_input from get_scraper_details, one per URL or query. collect_by_url returns one record per input; discover_by_* methods return up to limit_per_input records per input, and every record is billed. Waits up to 45 seconds; if still running it returns snapshot_id with status "running": then poll get_scraper_progress and call get_scraper_results when ready. Records with an "error" field explain failed inputs. Fields over 4,000 characters are left out and listed in omitted_fields; ask for them with include_fields.

tools.name: get_scraper_progress
tools.description: Status of a run: starting, running, ready, failed or canceled.

tools.name: get_scraper_results
tools.description: Records of a finished run. Returns status "running" if not ready yet. Fields over 4,000 characters are left out and listed in omitted_fields; ask for them with include_fields.

tools.name: scraping_browser_navigate
tools.description: Open a URL in a real Chrome browser run by Bright Data. Slower than scrape_as_markdown (about 5s per page): use it when scraping returns empty or blocked content, or the page needs JavaScript, scrolling, clicking or typing. Returns only the final URL and title; read the page with scraping_browser_get_text, scraping_browser_snapshot or scraping_browser_screenshot. If it fails (some pages are unavailable to the browser), the previous page stays open: do not read that as the new page.

tools.name: scraping_browser_go_back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page in the browser history, like the Back button. Returns the URL and title.

tools.name: scraping_browser_go_forward
tools.description: Go forward to the next page in the browser history, like the Forward button. Returns the URL and title.

tools.name: scraping_browser_snapshot
tools.description: List the elements of the current page with ref IDs (e.g. [e23]) to pass to scraping_browser_click_ref, scraping_browser_type_ref, scraping_browser_fill_form, scraping_browser_scroll_to_ref and scraping_browser_wait_for_ref. Take a new snapshot after the page changes: refs from an old one may point at other elements. To read the page text use scraping_browser_get_text; to see the layout use scraping_browser_screenshot.

tools.name: scraping_browser_click_ref
tools.description: Click an element (link, button, tab, checkbox) by its ref from the latest scraping_browser_snapshot. Returns a confirmation only: take a new snapshot or call scraping_browser_get_text to see what changed.

tools.name: scraping_browser_type_ref
tools.description: Type text into a text field by its ref from the latest scraping_browser_snapshot, replacing what it holds. Set submit to press Enter afterwards, e.g. to run a search. Returns a confirmation only: read the page again to see the result.

tools.name: scraping_browser_screenshot
tools.description: Take a PNG screenshot of the current page and return it as an image: for layout, charts, images or anything that is not text. Needs a model that can read images. Captures the visible window unless full_page is set.

tools.name: scraping_browser_network_requests
tools.description: List the network requests the current page made since it was opened: method, URL and status of each. Useful to find the API a page loads its data from, or why content is missing.

tools.name: scraping_browser_wait_for_ref
tools.description: Wait until an element, by its ref from the latest scraping_browser_snapshot, is visible, e.g. results that appear after a click. Fails after timeout.

tools.name: scraping_browser_fill_form
tools.description: Fill several form fields in one call (text boxes, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, sliders), each by its ref from the latest scraping_browser_snapshot. Does not submit the form: click its submit button with scraping_browser_click_ref.

tools.name: scraping_browser_get_text
tools.description: Return the visible text of the current page (its innerText): no links, images or markup. Reads the page already open and loads nothing: call scraping_browser_navigate first. If that failed, this returns the previous page. For a page that does not need a browser, scrape_as_markdown is faster and keeps links.

tools.name: scraping_browser_get_html
tools.description: Return the HTML of the current page: the <body> only, or the whole document with <head> and scripts when full_page is true. Usually much larger than scraping_browser_get_text: use it only when you need markup such as attributes, link targets or tables. For a page that does not need a browser, scrape_as_html is faster.

tools.name: scraping_browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll to the bottom of the current page so content that loads as you scroll (feeds, lazy images, "load more" lists) appears. Call it again for more, then read the page again.

tools.name: scraping_browser_scroll_to_ref
tools.description: Scroll an element into view by its ref from the latest scraping_browser_snapshot, e.g. to load the content around it or before a screenshot.

tools.name: get_stats_file
tools.description: Where this server logs timing stats: one JSON line per tool call (time, tool, duration in ms, success or error, retry attempts). Returns the file path and file:// link, how many calls it holds and the first and last call time.

api_token.title: API Token
api_token.description: Your Bright Data API token from https://brightdata.com/cp/setting/users

web_unlocker_zone.title: Web Unlocker Zone
web_unlocker_zone.description: Custom Web Unlocker zone name (default: mcp_unlocker)

browser_zone.title: Browser Zone
browser_zone.description: Browser API zone name for browser automation (default: mcp_browser)
